content_sections.heading: TDFC Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: TDFC has announced annual remuneration for all four technical positions. The Senior Programmer post offers Rs. 12 lakh per annum, while the Programmer post carries Rs. 7.5 lakh per annum. The remuneration and work mode for each position are given below.

content_sections.heading: TDFC Recruitment 2026 Contract Period
content_sections.text: The recruitment is for contractual appointments with an initial contract period of one year. Candidates should note that the advertised positions are not described as regular permanent appointments.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for TDFC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit the prescribed bio-data form along with documentary proof supporting their eligibility. The official application form specifies the following documents and details. Completed bio-data application form Recent passport-size colour photograph Date of birth proof Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Class/grade and percentage of marks details Experience certificates, wherever required Employment history with organisation details, designation, employment period, nature of work and salary drawn Applicants must provide sufficient supporting documents. TDFC has stated that applications with incomplete information or insufficient documentary proof will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Offline for TDFC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their completed application form through Registered Post or Speed Post. Applications should reach the specified TDFC office address on or before 8 November 2026. The Managing Director Tamil Nadu Transport Development Finance Corporation Limited Tamil Nadu Tourism Office Complex, 4th Floor No. 2, Walajah Road Chennai - 600002 Tamil Nadu Last Date: 8 November 2026 Candidates should ensure that the application reaches the office by the deadline. The recruitment notification prescribes submission through Registered Post or Speed Post.

content_sections.heading: TDFC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The TDFC Recruitment 2026 notification was released under Notification No. 1/2026 on 16 October 2026. The four-page document contains the vacancy announcement, educational qualifications, experience requirements, age limits, annual remuneration, work modes and prescribed bio-data form. The application form is provided on pages 3 and 4 of the recruitment document. Candidates should read the complete notification before sending their application. TDFC Official Website

content_sections.heading: TDFC Recruitment 2026 Application Form
content_sections.text: Candidates must use the prescribed bio-data form provided in the official recruitment document. The form requires personal details, educational qualifications, employment history and the applicant's signed declaration. Applications are accepted by post with the required information and supporting documents. No online application submission procedure is specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Tamil Nadu Transport Development Finance Corporation Ltd. (TDFC) to fill various technical and managerial positions on a contract basis in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under TDFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for posts including Senior Programmer, Programmer, Database Administrator (DBA), and Project Manager across different departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled offline application form along with required documentary proofs by Registered or Speed post is 8 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the Programmer posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech/MCA/B.Sc degree in Computer Science or related fields as specified in the official notification to be eligible for these technical positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range offered for TDFC positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 7.5 Lakhs to Rs. 12 Lakhs per annum depending on the specific post, qualification, and required prior experience of the candidate.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for TDFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates need to fill out the bio-data form and mail it via Registered or Speed post to the TDFC office in Chennai.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Manager position is below 40 years as per the guidelines provided in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to TDFC posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting the offline application form for any of the advertised positions.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be enclosed with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose documentary proofs for date of birth, educational qualifications, class and percentage of marks, and relevant experience certificates along with the bio-data form.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form should be sent by Registered or Speed post to Tamil Nadu Transport Development Finance Corporation Ltd., No. 2, Walajah Road, Tamil Nadu Tourism Office Complex 4th Floor, Chennai – 600002.
